slides.headline: BUSINESS OWNERS ARE CANCELLING THEIR VIRTUAL ASSISTANTS AFTER SETTING UP THESE 5 CLAUDE PROJECTS.

slides.headline: 2) TRAIN CLAUDE TO WRITE EVERY EMAIL IN YOUR VOICE

slides.headline: 3) BUILD A PROPOSAL WRITER THAT KNOWS YOUR OFFER COLD

slides.headline: 4) CREATE A WEEKLY REVIEWER THAT FLAGS YOUR BIGGEST PROBLEM FIRST
